title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise
excerpt: US stocks rebounded sharply on Monday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive following pressure from President Donald Trump, reversing part of last week’s tech-led market rout. title: Japanese bond yields fall as lower oil prices ease inflation concerns
excerpt: Japanese government bond yields declined due to falling oil prices that eased inflation concerns. The 10-year JGB yield reached a two-week low of 2.715%. title: South Korea’s Kospi rockets 8% as AI-linked stocks get breather after Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO. Worst over?
excerpt: South Korean shares have bounced back sharply after previously hitting a ten-month low, with the KOSPI index climbing 7.19%. This surge was largely driven by a rebound in technology stocks, particularly following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to leadership. Notable AI companies such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix recorded substantial gains, while foreign investments showed a positive trend with net purchases totaling 497.3 billion won.

title: Investors mint Rs 34.61 lakh cr in November as markets rally nearly 11%
excerpt: In a remarkable surge this month, Indian equity markets have observed a substantial upswing, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 percent. This rally was largely propelled by foreign institutional investors, who contributed record-setting inflows exceeding Rs 1 lakh crore. Motivated by lower crude oil prices and impressive Q2 earnings, investor optimism soared, although a recent profit booking saw a minor dip of nearly 2 percent.

title: Investors become richer by ₹34.61 trillion as Sensex surges in November
excerpt:
Equity markets have rallied sharply this month, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 per cent, making equity investors richer by Rs 34.61 lakh crore amid strong foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, better-than-expected Q2 earnings and a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks.
The 30-share BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 7,976.46 points, or 10.71 per cent till November 23.
Following the bullish trend in equities, the market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies has surged by Rs 34.61 lakh crore to Rs 5,08,98,444.87 crore (USD 5.48 trillion) this month.

title: IIFCL IPO: Govt plans to sell part of its stake, company to issue fresh shares
excerpt: The government aims to partially divest its shareholding in India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd through an initial public offering. The IPO is expected to occur by the end of the current fiscal year, according to an official statement. IIFCL will issue fresh shares to raise capital alongside the government stake sale. The proceeds from the stake sale will contribute to the government's disinvestment revenue.

title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei sells shares worth USD 280.41 million following IPO
excerpt: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, sold shares worth USD 280.41 million after the company's IPO. He reported holding 202.8 million shares and additional shares through trusts. Despite the decline, shares remained above their initial offering price of USD 83.

title: A 50 bps jumbo rate hike can lead to financial stability concerns, hurt growth: Report
excerpt: SBI economists have lowered their rate hike expectations for the upcoming RBI policy review. They now anticipate a 0.25 per cent increase rather than the previously expected 0.50 per cent. ai.title_te: SBI ఆర్థికవేత్తలు: RBI 50bps వడ్డీ పెంచకపోవచ్చు, 25bps మాత్రమే పెంచే అవకాశం
ai.summary: SBI ఆర్థికవేత్తలు తమ అంచనాలను మార్చుకున్నారు. వారు ఇప్పుడు RBI తదుపరి పాలసీ సమావేశంలో 0.50% (50bps) బదులుగా 0.25% (25bps) వడ్డీ రేటు పెంచే అవకాశం ఉందని అంచనా వేస్తున్నారు. ఆర్థిక స్థిరత్వం మరియు వృద్ధిపై ప్రభావాన్ని దృష్టిలో పెట్టుకుని ఈ మార్పు చేశారు.
ai.summary_te: SBI ఆర్థికవేత్తలు తమ అంచనాలను మార్చుకున్నారు. వారు ఇప్పుడు RBI తదుపరి పాలసీ సమావేశంలో 0.50% (50bps) బదులుగా 0.25% (25bps) వడ్డీ రేటు పెంచే అవకాశం ఉందని అంచనా వేస్తున్నారు. ఆర్థిక స్థిరత్వం మరియు వృద్ధిపై ప్రభావాన్ని దృష్టిలో పెట్టుకుని ఈ మార్పు చేశారు.
ai.why: వడ్డీ రేట్లు పెరగడం లేదా తగ్గడం బ్యాంకింగ్ రంగం లాభాలను, ఇతర రంగాల ఖర్చులను ప్రత్యక్షంగా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది. 25bps పెంపు అంటే మార్కెట్‌కు కొంత ఊపిరి పీల్చుకునే అవకాశం ఉంది.
ai.why_it_matters_te: వడ్డీ రేట్లు పెరగడం లేదా తగ్గడం బ్యాంకింగ్ రంగం లాభాలను, ఇతర రంగాల ఖర్చులను ప్రత్యక్షంగా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది. 25bps పెంపు అంటే మార్కెట్‌కు కొంత ఊపిరి పీల్చుకునే అవకాశం ఉంది.

ai.impact_reason_te: వడ్డీ రేట్లు తక్కువగా పెరిగితే, బ్యాంకులు తమ డిపాజిట్లకు చెల్లించాల్సిన వడ్డీ తగ్గుతుంది, కానీ లోన్ వడ్డీ కూడా అంతగా పెరగదు. దీనివల్ల బ్యాంకుల మార్జిన్లు స్థిరంగా ఉండే అవకాశం ఉంది.

title: Shift in pension and insurance money to equities dampens long-term G-sec demand: RBI DG
excerpt: The demand for long-term government securities has seen a marginal decline recently. Insurance companies and pension funds are increasingly focusing on equities instead of sovereign debt. This change has impacted the stability of the government securities market and highlighted challenges in liquidity distribution. The Reserve Bank of India emphasizes the need for a coordinated approach and broader participation from institutional investors.

title: PE/VC investments in India surge to USD 8.7 billion in October, highest monthly level in five years: EY-IVCA report
excerpt: Private equity and venture capital investments in India surged to USD 8.7 billion in October 2026. This monthly figure is the highest recorded in the past five years, supported by eight large deals totaling USD 7.3 billion. Financial services attracted the majority of investments, amounting to USD 5.9 billion during this period. Despite the increase in investments, exit activity declined, with 21 exits valued at USD 544 million.

title: IIFCL IPO: Govt to part sale stake, company to issue fresh shares
excerpt:
The government is looking to part sale its equity shareholding in IIFCL along with a fresh issue of shares by the company in the initial public offering (IPO), which is likely by the end of the current fiscal year, an official said.
The Cabinet had earlier this year approved the IPO and listing of India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd (IIFCL), and the work is on to file a draft paper with market regulator Sebi for approval.
Without disclosing the quantum of stake dilution, the official said that while the government will reduce its stake by an offer for sale, IFCL will issue fresh shares to raise capital in the IPO.
